response.text:
I can do that — I just need a few details and your confirmation before I create the recurring event and send invites.

Please either paste the note (so I can extract details) or confirm the items below:

Required / clarified fields
- Event title (from your note or give a different title)
- Attendees: who is “everyone”? (all members of a specific Google Group/team, a list of emails, or whole org?)
- First meeting date and start time (include time zone)
- Duration (e.g., 30 min, 1 hour)
- Recurrence pattern (e.g., weekly on Mondays; every other week; monthly on the 1st)
- End date or number of occurrences, or “no end”
- Location / conferencing: add a Google Meet link, Zoom, or physical room? (if Meet, I can add the default)
- Description / agenda text to include (or say “use note contents” if you pasted the note)
- Reminders/notifications (e.g., 10 minutes email/popup)

Permissions and delivery
- Do you want me to send invites now to attendees? (sending is externally visible)
- Which calendar should I create the event on? (your default calendar, or specify)

If you want defaults, I can propose them (examples: weekly Thursday 10:00–10:30 AM, Google Meet added, reminders 10 minutes before) — tell me which default to use or provide the missing fields. Once you confirm the final details I’ll create the recurring event.
